The Brick Homes (TBH) — logo identity (2019).

A real-estate mark that builds its meaning literally: the 'TBH' monogram sits inside a brick wall under a pitched roofline, so the logo reads, at a glance, as a little house made of its own name. Routes ran across colourways and a brick-wall lockup for 'The Brick Homes'.

Logo identity — Anirudh Kapoor. A·68.
